title: PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Conversion of Civil Service eligible lists into appointments for non-sworn classifications.
text:
[Council File 26-1322]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Conversion of Civil Service eligible lists into appointments for non-sworn classifications.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez - Harris-Dawson):
DIRECT the Personnel Department to report on the conversion of civil service eligible lists into appointments for non-sworn classifications, to include:
a. The average duration of eligible lists; the number of candidates placed on eligible lists, certified to Departments, and ultimately appointed.
b. Hard-to-fill classifications for which Departments have recurring or continuous hiring needs, including opportunities to increase the pool of qualified candidates for these positions; and the primary reasons candidates do not receive appointments.
c. Recommendations to:
i. Improve the City's exam-to-hire conversion rate
ii. Reduce the time between establishment of an eligible list and appointment iii. Identify any administrative, technological, or Civil Service Rule changes necessary to streamline the process
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
